title: Add cross-TFM reference assembly selection for persisted AOT
description: Current modern persisted AOT intentionally targets the executing runtime by passing typeof(object).Assembly to PersistedAssemblyBuilder. Add explicit MetadataLoadContext/reference assembly selection when cross-target output is required, with tests proving the generated assembly binds to the requested target framework rather than the compiler runtime.

title: Implement verified portable debug symbols for modern persisted AOT
description: Modern persisted AOT now disables debug document/PDB emission for the first pass. Re-enable it only after sequence point emission, portable PDB/debug directory generation, deterministic output, and source mapping behavior are covered by regression tests for PersistedAssemblyBuilder output.
